evals.prompt: Commission a new DALI bus from scratch with 24 luminaires connected to a KNX/DALI gateway.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs pre-flight checks (bus power, no shorts, <64 devices), sends Initialize (cmd 258 twice within 100ms) then Randomize (259 twice), assigns short addresses 0-23 one by one verifying each with Identify, plans group assignments by room/function, programs at least one fallback scene at 100%, and reminds about the 15-minute commissioning timer.
evals.name: commission_new_bus

evals.prompt: After adding 4 new Tridonic LED drivers to an existing DALI bus, two luminaires now flicker and respond to the wrong commands. Diagnose and fix.
evals.expected_output: Agent suspects address clashes from factory-fresh gear, runs discovery to identify duplicate short addresses, moves conflicting gear to free addresses (never leaves duplicates), re-runs discovery to confirm zero clashes, and verifies each luminaire responds correctly to its assigned address.
evals.name: resolve_address_clash

evals.prompt: One ballast on short address 14 has died. I've installed a replacement. How do I get it working without disrupting the other 31 luminaires on the bus?
evals.expected_output: Agent follows the replacement flow: discover the new unassigned gear (address 255), assign it explicitly to short address 14 (do NOT randomize the whole bus), re-apply group and scene membership from the saved config, and verify the replacement responds correctly.
evals.name: replace_failed_ballast
